verdict.rationale: Egnyte's own docs show external sharing with users outside the organization, and the ability to limit file shares to specific email addresses and revoke them. That is a form of link restriction, but it reads as per-share control rather than org-level admin governance. Watermark rules under 'Enhanced Sharing Controls' are an adjacent feature and earn no credit here. missing for 10: org-level admin policy controlling who may share externally, domain allowlists/blocklists, admin-enforced link restrictions (expiry, password, link types), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, external collaboration is governed — org-level controls over who can share outside the team, with domain allowlists or link restrictions

citations.quote: Limit file sharing to specific email addresses and revoke permissions when necessary.
Ability to share content with users who are not part of your organization.
